resources.name: Boulder Feet Forward (BFF)
resources.summary: Peer-led zero-barrier street outreach, basic needs, resource navigation, warm handoffs and case management.
resources.access: BFF Tuesdays 2:30–3:30 PM and Fridays 11:00 AM, southeast corner of Central Park, Boulder. Ask BFF staff for service-specific assistance.
resources.notes: Laundry vouchers and bus passes subject to availability; staff can assist with Coordinated Entry, benefits, education, and medical navigation. Tuesday pet supplies are managed by volunteer Lori, not Annie & Millie’s Place. Both events provide hygiene and toiletry supplies, with offerings varying by day. See individual event entries for exact times and conditions. Free menstrual products available at BFF events. Bike locks are sometimes available; ask staff, availability varies.

resources.name: The Community Project (TCP)
resources.summary: Clothing and gear at BFF partner events; volunteering opportunities. Phone program after approximately 40 volunteer hours; free device charging at BFF Tuesday and Friday events.
resources.access: Find TCP alongside BFF Tuesday/Friday events.
resources.notes: Not a separate TCP event. Free phone after approximately 40 volunteer hours and monthly bus passes for volunteers; reference may be available after sustained volunteering. TCP does not distribute tents. TCP provides a free device-charging station during BFF Tuesday and Friday events.

resources.name: Annie & Millie’s Place
resources.summary: Pet food and gear at Deacon’s Closet; periodic volunteer veterinary clinics, vaccines, and often spay/neuter help.
resources.access: At Deacon’s Closet; contact through BFF until direct number approved.
resources.notes: Ask Andy permission before publishing his phone number. Developing long-term foster program and seeking volunteer homes.

resources.name: Harvest of Hope
resources.summary: Food pantry and pet food; pet gear not provided.
resources.access: Pantry registration, no ID required according to BFF experience.
resources.notes: Pet food, not gear.

resources.name: All Roads
resources.summary: General adult shelter, housing case management, showers, laundry and limited lockers.
resources.access: 4869 N Broadway, Boulder; confirm service access on arrival.
resources.notes: Washer free; dryer $1. About 24 lockers, difficult to obtain. AcuDetox Tuesdays 11 AM–noon.
resources.petAccess: Ordinary pets allowed per BFF experience
resources.rules: BFF field knowledge: Guests can request the sober dorm; placement is not guaranteed. Ask about availability and intake rules.

resources.name: Focus ReEntry
resources.summary: Street-based case management, housing navigation, documents, and benefit support.
resources.access: Ask BFF for warm handoff.
resources.notes: Can receive phone deliveries for clients with arrangement; can assist with Coordinated Entry.

resources.name: OneHome / Coordinated Entry
resources.summary: Coordinated housing assessment and matching, not a first-come-first-served waiting list.
resources.access: Ask BFF, Focus ReEntry or All Roads for an assessment.
resources.notes: Keep in touch with housing case manager and explore other pathways while waiting. Reliable contact and documents matter.

resources.name: EFAA

resources.notes: Pantry generally best for people with access to a kitchen; family furniture assistance requires verification.

resources.name: Sister Carmen Community Center

resources.rules: BFF field knowledge: Ready to Work conducts full-panel substance testing, including legal substances. A positive result is not necessarily automatic dismissal but will trigger a response. This is transitional housing/employment, not a general walk-in shelter.
